title: Partner programme
description: Promote the Valstara pre-launch campaign with your own link and code, and earn 10% of what the customers you refer buy.
heading: The Valstara partner programme

sections.heading: How it works
paragraphs: You recommend. Your audience saves. You earn 10% of what they buy.

You get your own code and a permanent link. When someone joins the waitlist through either, they are recorded as referred by you. Valstara sells digital goods well below list price, and the people you send are covered by Valstara's guarantee.

sections.heading: The terms
paragraphs: You earn 10% of the order value, on all products, on every order placed by the customers you refer during the pre-launch campaign.
Those orders count from early access on 1 September 2027 until one year after public launch, on 1 October 2028. After that, a customer is no longer attributed to you under these terms.
One level only: there is no commission for recruiting other partners.

These terms apply only to partners accepted during the pre-launch campaign. The founding rate lasts that one year, and there is no lifetime lock. Customers you refer after public launch fall under the post-launch rates, which are agreed separately.
Earnings start with early access in September 2027. Commission is calculated and paid by the Valstara store after launch, never on this site.

sections.heading: How it compares
paragraphs: Our rate is more than triple GameSeal's commission rate, and double the rate of G2A and Eneba. Each comparison is with that programme's standard rate, and applies to these pre-launch terms only.

sections.heading: How to apply
paragraphs: Tell us who you are, where you would share Valstara and the code you would like. The founder reviews every application by hand.
If you are approved, you sign a short, plain-English contract sent by email. Your code and link go live once it is signed.
